panels.description: CPU use of running jails, normalized to the cores each jail may use.

targets.expr: (sylve_jail_cpu_usage_ratio{instance=~"$instance"} * on(job, instance, ctid) group_left(name) sylve_jail_info{instance=~"$instance"}) and on(job, instance, ctid) (sylve_jail_running{instance=~"$instance"} == 1)

panels.title: Jail CPU

panels.description: Summed process RSS of running jails, including descendant jails.

targets.expr: (sylve_jail_memory_rss_bytes{instance=~"$instance"} * on(job, instance, ctid) group_left(name) sylve_jail_info{instance=~"$instance"}) and on(job, instance, ctid) (sylve_jail_running{instance=~"$instance"} == 1)

panels.title: Jail memory

panels.description: CPU time as a share of each VM's configured vCPUs.

targets.expr: rate(sylve_vm_cpu_seconds_total{instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) / on(job, instance, rid) sylve_vm_vcpus{instance=~"$instance"} * on(job, instance, rid) group_left(name) sylve_vm_info{instance=~"$instance"}

panels.title: VM CPU

panels.description: Host RSS of each bhyve process, not memory used inside the guest.
panels.title: VM memory

panels.description: CPU time as a share of the cores each container may use. RACCT counts whole seconds, so short ranges look stepped.

targets.expr: rate(sylve_container_cpu_seconds_total{instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) / on(job, instance, ocid) sylve_container_cpu_cores{instance=~"$instance"} * on(job, instance, ocid) group_left(name) sylve_container_info{instance=~"$instance"}

panels.title: Container CPU
